questions.question_text:
What is the perimeter of the compound L-shape made with rectangles?
The total height is $12\,cm$, total width is $15\,cm$, the top width is $7\,cm$, and the inner vertical length is $7\,cm$. [tikz]\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.45]\draw[fill=blue!40] (0,0)--(15,0)--(15,5)--(7,5)--(7,12)--(0,12)--cycle;\end{tikzpicture}[/tikz]

options.why: Omits one or more boundary segments of the compound shape.
Uses an incorrect inferred length for an inner edge.
All missing edge lengths follow from the total height and width.

questions.solution_text: The missing inner horizontal length is $15-7=8$ cm and the missing right vertical length is $12-7=5$ cm. Thus the perimeter is $7+7+8+5+15+12=54$ cm.
